name: Conductrice blindée
historicalBrief: Fortune MGS2 reste identifiable au visage, cheveux, peau et posture; châssis graphite à conducteurs jaune pâle, bras dimensionnés pour le railgun, aucune copie du corps de Raiden.

supportPointQA.method: Read-only alpha segmentation of lowest8percent silhouette, equal weighting of separated boot intervals; lowest sole determines floor; retain far-foot perspective height difference.

prompt: Create exactly ONE finished 2D fighting-game character sprite on a completely transparent RGBA background. One full body only, isolated, entire head/hair, hands, all equipment and both boot soles fully inside the canvas with modest clear margins. Tall portrait canvas; character occupies about 87% of height. Right-facing three-quarter side view looking at the opponent to the right, grounded neutral combat-ready stance, no action sequence, no sprite sheet, no additional views, no text, no labels, no scenery, no glow cloud, no ground shadow, no rotation. Crisp detailed hand-painted/cel-shaded 2D game art with clean readable contours, natural anatomy and coherent mechanical detail. Use the attached identity reference ONLY for the appropriate same-period character, especially face, hairstyle, age, stature and defining equipment. The attachment contains multiple poses; choose its top-left standing figure as identity reference and render just one newly drawn figure. This is a NEW ORIGINAL CQC alternative costume, not an official Konami outfit and not a recovery of a lost image. FORTUNE, Metal Gear Solid 2 incarnation only, adult tall athletic Black woman with exact rich dark skin, distinctive long pale-blonde swept-back hair, greenish eyes and solemn face from attached first figure. Costume OC-008 Conductrice blindée: a completely original MGR-quality cybernetic chassis designed for HER electromagnetic railgun role, not a copy of Raiden. Full graphite-black layered armored shell, strong but athletic mechanical proportions matching her body, exposed precision joint bearings at shoulders/elbows/knees, pale-yellow protected conductor channels, large deliberate electromagnetic field-coil modules recessed along forearms and shoulders, armored hand grips suited to the heavy railgun. Dark graphite leg armor with pale yellow circuit accents, no white thigh armor, no gold ornamental discs, no bare human legs. Her actual uncovered human head/hair and neck remain identifiable. Hold the period Fortune long rectangular olive/dark railgun across body aimed safely right, weapon connected to load-supporting armature/harness; both hands anatomically correct on real grips. Elegant powerful neutral stance; no effect lightning, no glow clouds. Mechanical design should look as bespoke and engineered as Revengeance cyborgs, not clothing with metallic paint.
limits: New authored interpretation of the pre-established ORIGINAL CQC costume brief; not an official alternative costume.
